text: Put one Discharge Manager in place now. At 40 to 45 discharges a day, you already have the volume. The two Discharge Executives follow once the trial confirms your busy hours.
The team costs a small part of what the wait costs you, even on the most careful reading.
chat.pointer: Both lines are drawn to the same scale.
chat.note: The team costs about a hundredth of what the wait does.
